purpose: Cross-dataset transfer audit of the SUMO-locked asymmetric FAR-Cal design
issue_frequency: one systematically selected origin per hour across the chronological test stream
evaluation_cells: Sensors named by the active C3 event from event start through 12 bins after event end; non-event cells are excluded.
scalable_variant: Use causal age/context-weighted signed residuals from the sensor and its two-neighbor group, capped at the latest 256 records per sensor; blend with the matching frozen local archive under the locked stale-feedback rule.
inference: Paired moving-block bootstrap over time with 24 selected hourly origins per block (one day).
interpretation_boundary: This resource-bounded hourly transfer audit is supporting evidence and is not interchangeable with the full five-minute SUMO validation or a full registered real-data matrix.
